$comment: +++===+++ 2026-10-23 — Hasan Alizada — HAAL-062. ISO 8601 week of a date (FR-CAL-05: the week of the SELECTED date — the legacy app showed the week of today). Needed on the client (calendar header, offline; mini month week numbers in HAAL-097) and on the server (exports, agenda), hence two implementations against one contract.
purpose: Returns the ISO 8601 week number (1..53) of a date and the ISO week-based year it belongs to.

week_year.description: ISO week-based year; differs from the calendar year around 1 January.

invariants: week 1 is the week that contains the year's first Thursday (equivalently 4 January)
a year has 53 weeks when it starts on a Thursday, or is a leap year starting on a Wednesday
the result depends on the date only — never on a time zone, the user's week start or the current day
